dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: If only I had come a few days earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: This inn is great. The owner is friendly, and the service is good. We foreign merchants like staying here.

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: But there is one problem: the noise insulation is bad.

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: I could hear the buzz of conversation next door while lying in bed at night.

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: And I don't know if the man and woman next door were speaking in a dialect or something... I could understand the words but not the meaning.

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: The inn owner said that the person who was my neighbor was a researcher or something, and wrote papers all day.

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: Too bad it seems like he disappeared a few days ago, and the room's been let out. The people who moved in are a couple who can't stop yapping.

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: If I'd arrived a few days ago, I'd be done with my business and on my way, instead of being bothered by the noise all night and unable to sleep...
